blocks.section: 7.2.4 BATTERY, BATTERY DOOR, AND DOOR PAD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: 7.2.4 BATTERY, BATTERY DOOR, AND DOOR PAD REPLACEMENT

blocks.section: 7.2.4 BATTERY, BATTERY DOOR, AND DOOR PAD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Recommended tools for this procedure are a medium size flat blade screwdriver, an X-acto knife, mild solvent, and a lint-free cloth.

blocks.section: 7.2.4 BATTERY, BATTERY DOOR, AND DOOR PAD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: The replacement parts for this procedure are:

blocks.section: 7.2.4 BATTERY, BATTERY DOOR, AND DOOR PAD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Assembly, Battery, with Wire Harness Door, Battery Pad, Door

blocks.section: 7.2.4 BATTERY, BATTERY DOOR, AND DOOR PAD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Screw, 6-32 x 3/8, Hex Head, Slotted, with Washer

blocks.section: 7.2.4 BATTERY, BATTERY DOOR, AND DOOR PAD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: To replace the battery, battery door, and door pad, see Figure 7-2, then proceed as follows:

blocks.section: 7.2.4 BATTERY, BATTERY DOOR, AND DOOR PAD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Turn off the infuser and disconnect the device from AC power. The AC LED indicator will turn off.

blocks.section: 7.2.4 BATTERY, BATTERY DOOR, AND DOOR PAD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content:  Note: Wait five minutes for the microprocessor to save data and complete the turn off sequence before unplugging the battery.

blocks.section: 7.2.4 BATTERY, BATTERY DOOR, AND DOOR PAD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Place the infuser on its side.

blocks.section: 7.2.4 BATTERY, BATTERY DOOR, AND DOOR PAD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Using the flat blade screwdriver, remove the screw that secures the battery door to the infuser, and remove the door.

blocks.section: 7.2.4 BATTERY, BATTERY DOOR, AND DOOR PAD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Inspect the battery door and door pad for damage. Replace the door, if required.

blocks.section: 7.2.4 BATTERY, BATTERY DOOR, AND DOOR PAD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: If the battery door pad is defective, remove it and clean the door with mild solvent. Dry the battery door thoroughly, and install the replacement pad on the door.

blocks.section: 7.2.4 BATTERY, BATTERY DOOR, AND DOOR PAD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Disconnect the battery harness from the charger circuit cable. Carefully pull the battery harness wires and connector outside the enclosure, and remove the battery.

blocks.section: 7.2.4 BATTERY, BATTERY DOOR, AND DOOR PAD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Connect the replacement battery harness to the charger circuit cable, and insert the replacement battery into the enclosure.

blocks.section: 7.2.4 BATTERY, BATTERY DOOR, AND DOOR PAD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content:  Note: The  cable  connectors  are  keyed  so  that  cables  cannot  be  connected incorrectly.

blocks.section: 7.2.4 BATTERY, BATTERY DOOR, AND DOOR PAD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content:  Note: Confirm the battery harness is not pinched between the battery and the enclosure.

blocks.section: 7.2.4 BATTERY, BATTERY DOOR, AND DOOR PAD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Replace the battery door using the screw that was removed in step 3.

blocks.section: 7.2.4 BATTERY, BATTERY DOOR, AND DOOR PAD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Press the ON/OFF key with the infuser disconnected from AC power, and verify the front panel battery symbol illuminates.

blocks.section: 7.2.4 BATTERY, BATTERY DOOR, AND DOOR PAD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Access the BIOMED SETTINGS screen and press [CHANGE BATTERY] (see Figure 1-2) .

blocks.section: 7.2.4 BATTERY, BATTERY DOOR, AND DOOR PAD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Replacement of the battery door and door pad is routine maintenance and no verification procedure is normally required. However, if the infuser may have been damaged during these procedures, perform the PVT in Section 5.2 .
